svg.text: ESPACIO Dual Architecture & Design Principles Mapping
Backend Hexagonal Architecture (Spring Boot 3) + Frontend/Mobile MVVM (React MFEs) enforcing SOLID, DRY, KISS, Low Coupling/High Cohesion & GRASP

g.text: Architecture #1 — Backend Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters + DDD)
Outbound Ports: PropertyRepositoryPort, SlotLockPort, PaymentGatewayPort, VectorStorePort
Orchestrates @Transactional boundaries and OutboxEventRecorder without leaking DB details.
PURE JAVA 21 DOMAIN CORE (domain/model, domain/service, domain/event)
ZERO Framework Imports (Enforced by ArchUnit in CI — no Spring, JPA, Stripe, Mongo)
• Aggregates: Property (INV-01, INV-05), VisitRequest (INV-03, INV-04), PaymentTransaction
• Value Objects: RoomDimension, AccessSpecification, Money, VisitCheckInToken
• Pure Domain Services: SpaceFitCalculator (INV-02), RefundPolicyEvaluator (100% rules)
Dependency Rule: All arrows point INWARD toward Domain Core (SOLID: SRP, OCP, DIP)
Architecture #2 — Frontend & Mobile MVVM / Component-ViewModel Architecture
View Layer (React 19 Presentational Components & Astro Islands)
Zero direct fetch() or business formulas inside JSX components
• Declaratively binds to ViewModel state & dispatches user intent callbacks
ViewModel Layer (Custom React Hooks + Zustand Stores + TanStack Query)
• @espacio/auth-store (Zustand singleton: Keycloak PKCE state & RBAC selectors)
• PlatformAdapterProvider (injects Web vs Capacitor MLKit vs Electron safeStorage)
• @espacio/api-client: OpenAPI 3.0 generated DTOs & typed HTTP/WS clients
• @espacio/domain-utils: Pure TS Space-Fit INV-02 preview math & QR parsers
• @espacio/wasm-spatial: Rust .wasm 2D sketch compressor & offline QR verifier
Formal Mapping of 5 Engineering Design Principles Across ESPACIO Modules (Defense Reference)
• Astro ships 0 KB JS for public
